edges.notes: Server-side axios.request(options) in the detect route: options.url is the literal external host https://microsoft-translator-text-api3.p.rapidapi.com/detectlanguage (RapidAPI), not this repo
axios.delete(`/api/assistants/${assistantId}/files/${fileId}`) in handleFileDelete; root-relative, same origin, no basePath. files/[fileId]/route.ts exports DELETE
axios.post(`/api/assistants/${assistantId}/files`, formData) in handleUpload; root-relative, same origin. [assistantId]/files/route.ts exports POST
axios.post('/api/assistants', values) in onSubmit's create branch; root-relative, same origin. app/api/assistants/route.ts exports POST
axios.patch(`/api/assistants/${data.id}`, values) in onSubmit's update branch; root-relative, same origin. [assistantId]/route.ts exports PATCH
axios.delete(`/api/assistants/${data.id}`) in onDelete; root-relative, same origin. [assistantId]/route.ts exports DELETE
axios.patch(`/api/chat/${id}`, { name }) when renaming a chat; root-relative, same origin. chat/[chatId]/route.ts exports PATCH
axios.delete(`/api/chat/${id}`) when deleting a chat; root-relative, same origin. chat/[chatId]/route.ts exports DELETE
axios.delete(`/api/chat/folder/${id}`); the static folder segment wins over chat/[chatId], so it lands in chat/folder/[folderId]/route.ts, which exports DELETE
axios.patch(`/api/chat/folder/${id}`, { name }) when renaming a folder; static folder segment wins over chat/[chatId]. chat/folder/[folderId]/route.ts exports PATCH
axios.post('/api/chat', { name, ... }) in the new-chat dialog; root-relative, same origin. app/api/chat/route.ts exports POST
axios.post('/api/chat/folder', data); the static folder route wins over chat/[chatId] (which also exports POST). chat/folder/route.ts exports POST
axios.get('/api/stripe') for the checkout URL; root-relative, same origin. app/api/stripe/route.ts exports GET
axios.post('/api/images/generate', data); the static generate segment wins over images/[imageId] (which exports only PATCH). images/generate/route.ts exports POST
axios.post('/api/images', { photo, ... }) to save a generated image; root-relative, same origin. app/api/images/route.ts exports POST
axios.patch(`/api/images/${photo.id}`, { shared: true }); root-relative, same origin. images/[imageId]/route.ts exports PATCH
axios.get('/api/stripe') for the billing portal URL (then a window.location navigation, not labeled); root-relative, same origin. app/api/stripe/route.ts exports GET
axios.post('/api/translation/detect', { prompt }) in a debounced effect; root-relative, same origin. translation/detect/route.ts exports POST
